info.title: RidgeHQ public product facts API
info.description: Read-only JSON of the same already-public marketing facts published on https://www.ridgehq.app/ai and https://www.ridgehq.app/llms.txt. No authentication, no per-customer data. This is not the RidgeHQ application API; connecting an AI assistant to a RidgeHQ account over MCP requires an account and is described at https://www.ridgehq.app/docs.

get.summary: Product description, ideal and poor-fit customer profiles, security summary, company details, and canonical routes.
The activity-business verticals RidgeHQ serves and how each is supported.
Platform capabilities, products, and integrations with their current status.
Current pricing mode and terms. Treat https://www.ridgehq.app/pricing as the authoritative source.

Facts.description: JSON object with a lastUpdated date and the requested facts.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests from this client. Retry after the number of seconds in the Retry-After header.
